summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the new Image + Voice approval gates (iteration 20). All 15 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend image-approval-panel and voice-approval-panel render correctly with all required data-testids, and the storyboard/script sections are correctly hidden during the awaiting_image_approval / awaiting_voice_approval states. Single-image regen produces a cache-busted URL (?v=<epoch>), image approval transitions the project into voice generation within ~40s, voice regenerate {voice:'male'} switches preference, and E2E from create -> ready completes in ~76s per user. Existing script approval/regen/edit still works (regression pass).

minor.issue: Register rate limit (10/10min per IP) still causes serial test regression to 429 after ~10 registrations — same behaviour called out in iteration_19. Mitigated in tests by `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` between suites.

issues: Header shows '0 credits' after the initial 3-credit deduction — correct behaviour, but a paid user might not notice the balance drop. Minor UX, not a bug.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 2145 lines — still well over the 700-line guideline flagged in iteration_19. Recommend splitting into modules (auth.py, projects.py, pipeline.py, media.py) for maintainability. Not a blocker.

run_after_image_approval() (server.py:1699) does NOT refund the credit on failure — only run_pipeline() and run_after_script_approval() do. If OpenAI TTS fails between image approval and voice approval, the user loses their credit with no recovery. Consider adding the same refund block for voice + compose stages.

regen_single_image() catches all exceptions silently (except Exception at server.py:1695) and only logs — the endpoint at line 702 will return the pre-regen project doc to the caller with no indication of failure. Consider raising a 500 or setting an error flag on the project so the UI can toast an error.

POST /projects/{pid}/voice/regenerate accepts an arbitrary 'voice' string in payload and silently ignores unknown values (server.py:753). Consider returning 400 for invalid voices so the client knows the preference wasn't updated.

regenerate_all_images() at server.py:706 re-uses run_after_script_approval which will re-run all image generation from scratch — but it also RE-writes progress starting from 30% without accounting for the fact that user already saw 60%. Not a bug, cosmetic.
No rate limiting on POST /projects/{pid}/images/regenerate/{idx} — a malicious client could hammer image generation. Consider a per-project or per-user cooldown.
test_credentials: Dynamically-created TEST_iter20_<hex>@testmail.local and TEST_uir20_<hex>@testmail.local accounts, all with password 'secret123'. Newuser@test.com credit balance may or may not still have 3 credits — tests always create a fresh account.
seed_data_creation: None manually seeded — each test creates a fresh TEST_* prefixed user (auto-refill grants 3 free credits per account).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 20 verified. The full guided pipeline (script -> image -> voice -> ready) now has all three approval gates working and the frontend renders the correct panel per status. The backend regen_single_image helper appends ?v=<timestamp> to bust browser cache — this is intentional (see server.py:1692). If retesting, be aware /api/auth/register still throttles after 10 IP-registrations per 10 min — `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` clears the in-memory rate-limit store. Test artefacts: /app/backend/tests/test_iter20_image_voice_approval.py has 15 tests organised in 6 classes (TestAuthGating, TestStatusGate, TestGuidedPipelineE2E, TestSingleImageRegen, TestVoiceRegen, TestScriptRegression); each E2E-style test spends 3 credits + ~90s.
